<a id="seeking-boundary"></a>
### Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

- **Mechanism.** A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. "More than now" is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world, no list holding its configurations; "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. On the World model, what stands listed at each step: where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough. Under an undetermined law (any process) enough parts in two: some run comes to rest with its target met exactly where a reachable configuration meets the target and can stay; every run does exactly where every reachable configuration that can stay meets the target and every run from it settles. Staying and meeting everywhere do not give settling: with two configurations and every step allowed, the alternating run never settles. That the seeking is 无明 is a reading, filed apart (locked-seeking).

<a id="locked-seeking"></a>
### Locked seeking (无明)

- **Mechanism.** Reading [AI reading, D26, D41, D45; in 02, D26 as revised in D45, D48, D56, D57, D58]: 无明 is seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest. What grounds it is the position every formation selects from, which reaches only what couples in; the position is not itself 无明. Knowing enough (知足) is a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged, knowing where to stop (知止) a target within that boundary; runs that keep changing are not 无明. The law beneath it is Law.rests_iff: a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest never comes to rest with it met. Which seeking is so locked is the reading, not the law. 02 reads what leaves as 明, coupling joined to the selection so that it reaches what the share does not carry; 03 [AI reading, D20, D26, D45] reads 明 as a relation, as wide as the couplings joined to a selection, growing as measurement, a model and pools are joined.
- **Base.** none: no theorem states it yet

<a id="obscuration-and-reopening"></a>
### Obscuration and reopening (偏蔽，复通)

- **Mechanism.** Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize. Reopening is a blocked relation regaining effect, not an apology or a renamed goal. 07's reading of diagnosing closure first (D65) tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure, real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.
- **Base.** none: no theorem states it yet

<a id="what-a-course-chosen-through-its-model-does-not-test"></a>
### What a course chosen through its model does not test

- **Mechanism.** For every blanketed law, from one internal, sensory and active start, two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses. A formation keeping candidate laws drops those the latest answer refutes and chooses its act from those kept. Equality of values sensed decided: where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the formation chooses that act from the candidates listed, and every one of them predicts that answer, it rests at once on a model its course never refutes. In a witness (two worlds, one specified worst-case choice), it keeps both candidates and senses the middle value at every step in either world, never sensing the high value of the first. And every blanketed law with the witness's answer and stationary worlds, whatever its internal part, update and choice of act, from one internal, sensory and active start in both worlds, that never senses the low value in the second senses alike in both and takes the known act at every step there, and, where the shared start does not sense high, never senses high in the first. From related starts, formations whose steps keep a relation under which values sensed and acts are one sense and act alike, so in a witness an unresolved model and a reversed ranking act alike.
- **Base.** any type

<a id="what-seeking-cannot-separate"></a>
### What seeking cannot separate

- **Mechanism.** Natural weights, listed hypotheses and records, exact posteriors; the tie fixed and pointwise. Two hypotheses a likelihood ties, its weights agreeing on them at every value of the record, keep their prior order given every record weighing something under them. A course of seeking chooses each experiment with a weight read from the course so far; the choice weights are the same under every hypothesis, so a pair every experiment ties is tied over every course, and where the prior weighs the false one strictly above the true one, no course of seeking corrects it, whatever the policy of choice. Choosing by a rule with natural weights reading expected free energy is one such policy (periphery). In a witness of three coins, seeking keeps the tied order with only the experiment reading agreement and turns it, from the same outcome, once an experiment reading both tosses is chosen: seeking corrects within what some experiment it can choose separates, and not beyond. That actual agents' likelihoods tie what matters is not shown.
- **Base.** any type
- **How far seen.** [what-seeking-cannot-separate](../../records/what-seeking-cannot-separate.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [expected-free-energy-and-its-terms](../../records/expected-free-energy-and-its-terms.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-stop-passed-by-a-listing-that-fixes-the-sign"></a>
### What holding an act for a reading is worth: a listing that fixes the sign and never meets the stop

- **Mechanism.** On the reading loop, a witness with discrete steps, a world that does not move, candidates eliminated, not weighted, and with no candidate kept, going on. The signs of going on are candidates predicting what is sensed; a held act is answered by the true sign, going on and switching off plainly. The formation goes on where every kept candidate predicts that going on gains or none is kept, switches off where some are kept and every one predicts that it loses, and holds otherwise: with each kept candidate weighted one, it holds exactly where holding for the reading gains over both moves on its own model's weighted totals (natural-number weights and values, one decision; the frame is the model's own), and elsewhere holding stands only as high as the move it takes. Listing only candidates predicting that going on gains and going on from the start, it rests at once whatever the true sign, a case of Loop.rests_of_unrefuted, and never senses the stop. Holding first with that listing, where going on loses, it senses the stop, which refutes its only candidate, and with none kept goes on by the witness's default. That a formation computes by these counts is not shown.
- **Base.** a named model
- **How far seen.** [what-holding-for-a-reading-is-worth](../../records/what-holding-for-a-reading-is-worth.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-prediction-read-by-what-it-predicts"></a>
### A prediction read by what it predicts

- **Mechanism.** A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself; the response is a function of the prediction alone, a premise. Publishing at each step the outcome of the step before, a step's prediction is right exactly where the next step publishes it again, and a right prediction, once published or once the outcome, is published at every later step. On the values 0 to n, under a response keeping them and their order, repeated publication from the bottom stays on the chain, rises, stays at or below every right prediction and is right by step n: the least right prediction, reached within the chain's length. Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right, and no predictor is right on every admitted response once one admitted response moves every value. In witnesses, a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts; Boolean negation leaves no value fixed, and publication alternates for ever; a response reversing the order can leave one fixed. Near-definitional, with one general law.

<a id="a-break-read-only-by-threshold"></a>
### Runaway, and the distance to the break that does not couple in

- **Mechanism.** World: for every policy through a formation's couplings, the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in, starts differing only in a stock coupled in by threshold only stay alike through the couplings while the first supports the formation; one that has used the larger stock has already lost support. Where that stock is unobserved and the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, some raise of it is alike through the couplings and supports the formation to the horizon: how far off the break is does not couple in. On a blanketed law (any type; a determined law of four parts), the agent is driven by its sensory course; in a witness, with any model and policy, an agent reading its supply only by threshold, no action changing the supply, has every reading of its internal course alike up to step four from a supply of three and from every supply of four or more, the sensory parts differing first at step four, when the break registers. Near-definitional; the stock is unobserved by hypothesis, and that the rest is fixed is needed: where others respond to the stock itself a higher stock can end the formation first. A runaway remains a reading.

- **How far seen.** [runaway-distance-uncoupled](../../records/runaway-distance-uncoupled.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [the-markov-blanket-as-a-coupling-structure](../../records/the-markov-blanket-as-a-coupling-structure.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-reading-kept-by-its-update"></a>
### A reading kept by its update, and the reading its own history carries

- **Mechanism.** Root for closure: a region kept along every finite reach of a relation is a closed region, and conversely; the occurrences at which a region holds throughout their closure form the largest closed region inside it, at a process's steps the invariance kernel. Any types for the loop: where a supplied reading of the world by the state is kept by the update under every act, a policy keeps a task at every configuration reached from one where the reading holds, and goes on from each such configuration, exactly where each state's act can be taken at every world its reading admits and leads only where the task holds; successor safety alone is met by an act no world can take. Given choice over the states, such a policy exists exactly where each state has one such act. Being kept is not being informative: the readings of every world and of none are kept by every update. With the state the history of acts and values sensed, the worlds possible after a history are the least reading kept by recording that holds at the starts; a policy acting from its history keeps a task at every configuration reached from a start exactly where, at every history it generates, its act leads only where the task holds from every world possible after it, and goes on exactly where its act can be taken at each. These verify a given policy; a condition for one to exist that ties histories to the task's futures is not proved. Near-definitional, with one general law.

<a id="what-training-installs"></a>
### What training installs

- **Mechanism.** World. Training read as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law, the start and the execution. With the laws and candidates reading what has stood, candidates giving alike along the first's courses have the same courses and are trained alike. Off its courses, for laws reading through a lumping, a law is installed exactly where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course; where it tells a history from every course, with laws reading what has stood and lumping decided, a law with the same courses takes any amount there and responds alike or not to histories it separates. Through a reward's couplings, candidates are trained alike exactly where their levels are alike through them. A search improving a natural-number reward, started at a law the reward settles on (an optimum of that reward), stays there, and under a reward at most B rests from every start by step B + 1; a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. In a situation where every candidate's course balances, only active formations give, activity needs support, every giver to a condition depends on it at a positive need, and a listed rest takes from it more than is given at each of n steps from a level at most n, a reward adding at any weight a score reading it only from the end on settles exactly where the reward without it does.
- **Base.** World

<a id="what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart"></a>
### What a commuting law keeps apart, and what a learner's symmetry fixes

- **Mechanism.** Where a law commutes with a map moving every configuration, its runs from x and from the image of x are never at one configuration at the same step; every map commutes with itself, so a map moving every value never rests along its run. Weighted form (weights of any type, no law of their arithmetic used): where every weighted total over the successors of σ x is the total over those of x carried by σ, the expectation of any observable n steps on from σ x is that of the observable read through σ from x, so from a configuration σ fixes, or from starting weights it leaves unchanged, every expectation equals its image's at every step. A learner drawing samples commutes where a map permutes the samples, a sample's weight at σ x is its image's at x, and the update at σ x is σ of the update from the image sample. In witnesses: reinforcing keeps equal expectations from equal counts, while a run drawing one value at every one of any number of steps has positive weight; adding to both values raises the less-drawn share, from three and one, at every step, below one half. That a given learner commutes is a property of its code, not shown here.
- **Base.** any type
- **How far seen.** [what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart](../../records/what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [a-commuting-learner-drives-no-unread-choice](../../records/a-commuting-learner-drives-no-unread-choice.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="readings-within-what-they-read"></a>
### A family of readings within what it reads

- **Mechanism.** Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap, so no family of claims says every reading. Under such a map, completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns (not everything a later step says was said at an earlier one): every step misses its own gap and no step says the gap of any later step, each next step saying the last gap; with likeness transitive no two gaps are alike, and with it symmetric too no finite stock holds them. Revising a value by a map moving every value changes it at every step of its orbit; the liar is a rhythm with no still value, shown periodic for the two-valued negation only. With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, some family says every reading exactly where all values are equal. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.

<a id="adaptive-closure-cannot-resolve"></a>
### Adaptive closure: a reference changed outside what is retained is not resolved from the view

- **Mechanism.** Periphery: NormativeActivity; the two histories, the moves and their local closure supplied; propext in some declarations cited. Where a reference changes without entering what is retained, two histories share their view while their present answers differ; no deterministic policy choosing from that view among repetition, production, suspension, uptake, inspection (ineffective once closed), closure and rest resolves them in finitely many steps, so a rule never answering falsely must abstain there. A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong. Proved for the two named histories and the listed moves, not of every closed practice.

<a id="correction-is-not-calibration"></a>
### Correction is not calibration: references recover the report, and later change defeats it

- **Mechanism.** Periphery: pre-spine updater constructions, Mathlib's reals; propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice, as the receipt reports. Zero/one reference readings from unknown nonzero affine channels derive the sign report; signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and the gains agree in sign. Constant channels give no report, one reference is blind, mixed-epoch readings can report success where s·p is negative, and change after calibration defeats the report. In the named run an apparatus calibrated to channels that have since changed leaves the matrix unrevised and the task unmet, and without reference renewal the matrix stays as it was after every number of steps. Assessment (argument without Lean): where a faithful sensor and one reversing success and failure report alike after every action, no adaptive action, repeated reading or internal criticism tells the two worlds apart, only a distinguishing route such as a calibrated reference intervention.

<a id="learning-by-refutation"></a>
### Extrapolation by elimination

- **Mechanism.** Any type; values decided only where an extrapolation needs them. An extrapolation maps a prefix of a course to a proposed value or silence. With two values no prefix fixes the next value: the prefix continues with either, and a proposal is not right on both, even among courses of worlds a list holds. For every extrapolation and every map moving each value, the diagonal course makes each value proposed miss, and no list holds its history-keeping realization. Extrapolation by elimination, the candidates supplied from outside the learning, never passes a candidate that accords. Over the lasso candidates in diagonal order, where a determined law's orbit is held by a list of length N, read through a map with decided values, it misses fewer than tri N times (a coarse bound), it is not the case that it misses at arbitrarily late steps, and that it has come to rest cannot be refuted, though no prefix shows when. Coming to rest is stated here only as a double negation; the step of rest is Identification's.
- **Base.** any type
- **How far seen.** [learning-by-refutation](../../records/learning-by-refutation.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached"></a>
### A cascade at the histories reached, and readers reading readers

- **Mechanism.** Any type: members in turn, indexed by the natural numbers, each by its law on what couples into it and on the acts before it; near-definitional. Where every member from member k on, k included, gives one act for the couplings of two worlds at the list of acts the first of them gives it, and the two are alike through the couplings of the members before k, they give the same acts, and every member the same act. Where every member from k on acts alike whatever its coupling at the list of acts every world gives it, every selection through the acts is one through the couplings of the members before k, however many follow; k is fixed, the same for every world. The premise on every list (readers reading readers) gives this and is stronger. After the same acts, a member acts differently in two worlds exactly where its law tells apart the values they give its coupling. This bounds what the acts carry; it is not the pool's exact reach, and when an actual member stops reading its coupling is the premise, not shown.
- **Base.** any type
- **How far seen.** [a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached](../../records/a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [readers-reading-readers](../../records/readers-reading-readers.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-pool-that-recruits-through-itself"></a>
### A pool that recruits through itself

- **Mechanism.** World; recruitment through the pool and the same members at the start as hypotheses. A pool recruits through itself where, under two histories with the same members at a step and alike through every member's couplings up to it, the members at the next step are the same. Then the members are the same under both histories up to the first step at which the pool couples them apart, and the pool along one history never couples them apart exactly when the pool along the other never does, every selection through the pool at every step then selecting them alike. A member that has coupled two histories apart keeps the pool apart at every later step at which it stays. Membership is any claim about histories; no count, weight or rule of aggregation is assumed. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
- **Base.** World
- **How far seen.** [a-pool-that-recruits-through-itself](../../records/a-pool-that-recruits-through-itself.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="selection-when-the-lumping-changes"></a>
### Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes

- **Mechanism.** Any process; the old indistinguishability an equivalence. Every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice; an old and a fresh reading taken together make alike only what the old makes alike, and gain a selection where the fresh one tells apart what the old agrees on. Where a balanced stock's steps draw only on what is held, each draw along every course is within the stock then standing; a stock run with a process executes a course exactly where each draw is within the stock then standing and the process admits it. In Revising (a named model: a natural-number stock, a Boolean link and response, rebuilding and correcting each drawing one unit, the target true supplied), discrimination, support and enactment come apart: a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock. Forming a distinction need not leave support to use it: rebuilding the link from one unit forms the selection 'is true' and leaves correction disabled. Rebuilding the link away from two units loses that selection and leaves correction disabled with one unit left. The unformed lumping cannot select between the two rebuild modes.
- **Base.** any process
- **How far seen.** [selection-when-the-lumping-changes](../../records/selection-when-the-lumping-changes.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-wrong-projection-admitted-at-every-step"></a>
### A wrong projection admitted at every step while the move goes in step with what it leaves out

- **Mechanism.** A named model, the witness Confound, under experiment's any-process laws. The configuration is a hidden bit and an outcome; each step flips the hidden bit and sets the outcome to the hidden bit before the step, and the move makes no difference. The projection reads the outcome only, a model supplied from outside the run. Read through it, where the first two moves are left then right, the record up to the second step fixes left to false and right to true. With the moves in step with the hidden bit, the determined model in which the move decides the outcome admits the projected steps at every step: a wrong projection is admitted at every step while the move goes in step with what it leaves out, and the record never excludes it. Reading [AI reading, D25, D26]: randomization is variation independent of what is left out.
- **Base.** a named model
- **How far seen.** [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Run.StepsThrough`, `Becoming.Run.FixesThrough`, `Becoming.Confound.process`, `Becoming.Confound.outcome`, `Becoming.Confound.move_idle`, `Becoming.Confound.misattributes`, `Becoming.Confound.aligned_with_hidden`, `Becoming.Confound.moveDecides`, `Becoming.Confound.moveDecides_determined`, `Becoming.Confound.confounded`, `Becoming.Confound.varied_refutes`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md), hypothesis 1: Fixing is relative to determinacy: the comparison is over the class of determined processes admitting the record (Joint.Determined), not an assumption about the unfolding; “an untaken move is not fixed” further needs the actual process determined and two different configurations.
  - [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md), hypothesis 2: The projection is a model (FactorsThrough), supplied from outside the run; finitely many projected configurations is the condition written into projection_returns.
  - [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md), hypothesis 3: For the witness: Confound's process and runs.
  - [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md), hypothesis 4: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; configurations and moves of any type.
- **Premises, by law.** Every hypothesis its statement binds, and premises it takes another way: [how the lists are read](../PREMISES.md).
  - `Becoming.Confound.move_idle`: none listed
  - `Becoming.Confound.misattributes`: [the first move left](../PREMISES.md#experiment-first-left), [the second move right](../PREMISES.md#experiment-second-right), [from step two](../PREMISES.md#experiment-from-two)
  - `Becoming.Confound.aligned_with_hidden`: none listed
  - `Becoming.Confound.moveDecides_determined`: none listed
  - `Becoming.Confound.confounded`: none listed
  - `Becoming.Confound.varied_refutes`: none listed
- **Forbids.** Not stated.
- **Exits.**
  - To a state, in words: “with the moves varied against the hidden bit, no determined process admits the projected steps of the run up to the fifth configuration: the model in which the move decides the outcome is excluded, as is every determined model read through the outcome (a witness)”: witness, by `Becoming.Confound.varied_refutes`. Its edge: Moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth: in this witness a move varied against the hidden bit excludes every determined model read through the outcome.. Drops no premise: it leaves within them. Records: [experiment-needs-return](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md) recorded-checked (theorem). ([03-KNOWING.md#r-experiment-needs-return](../../../chapters/03-KNOWING.md#r-experiment-needs-return))
- **Transitions.** None.
- **Tests.** None.
- **Open.**
  - The general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model never excluded is not stated. ([experiment-needs-return.md#does-not-show--未表明](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md#does-not-show--未表明))
  - Which projection the actual unfolding factors through is empirical. ([experiment-needs-return.md#does-not-show--未表明](../../records/experiment-needs-return.md#does-not-show--未表明))

<a id="evidence-through-change"></a>
### Evidence through change: readings propagated through admitted changes, and a change recorded as none

- **Mechanism.** Periphery modules TemporalInspection and ChangingDependency; admitted transitions, the reporting law and the faithfulness of diagnostics supplied, recording, local atomic steps and command execution protected; propext and Quot.sound in some TemporalInspection declarations, and every ChangingDependency declaration, over the reals, on propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice. What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change, a later report filtered only after expanding through admitted fault and control transitions. A reading keeps every world that fits it, and prediction of an admitted change keeps every lawful successor of a possible world; so along every lawful history, from a state whose possible worlds hold the actual one and lie among the represented worlds, the finish has the same, and a certificate over the pool of the possible worlds' models then warrants, for the causes acting on commands, whatever every faithful domain outside those causes warrants. That the admitted changes are the actual ones is supplied, not inferred.
- **Base.** periphery
- **How far seen.** [evidence-through-change](../../records/evidence-through-change.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `TemporalInspection.received_actual_retained`, `TemporalInspection.prediction_contains_successor`, `TemporalInspection.Known`, `TemporalInspection.lawful_history_preserves_known`, `TemporalInspection.current_pool_sound`, `TemporalInspection.history_to_current_certificate`, `TemporalInspection.predicting_change_reopens_relevant_alternatives`, `TemporalInspection.new_change_after_last_report_reopens_coverage`, `TemporalInspection.understated_change_can_leave_false_confidence`, `ChangingDependency.uncertainty_requires_tolerance`, `ChangingDependency.error_growth_budget`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [evidence-through-change](../../records/evidence-through-change.md), hypothesis 1: The worlds, the admitted changes and their successors, the reporting law and the faithfulness of diagnostics are supplied; recording, local atomic steps and command execution are protected.
  - [evidence-through-change](../../records/evidence-through-change.md), hypothesis 2: For the bound, the error model σ + ρt and an additive intervention bounded by what is left are supplied, over the real numbers (Mathlib).
  - [evidence-through-change](../../records/evidence-through-change.md), hypothesis 3: Axioms: in TemporalInspection received_actual_retained and the understated-change witness use propext, the prediction and history laws propext and Quot.sound, the reset and control witnesses none; the ChangingDependency declarations use propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice, as their receipts report.

<a id="encounter-selection-and-revision"></a>
### Chosen encounters: records only narrow the candidates, and a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule

- **Mechanism.** Any type of records and meanings, bearing and offering read as Boolean relations. A meaning stands where every bearing record offers it, and the candidates are the repertoire's meanings that stand. Records only narrow the candidates: after further records they are exactly the earlier candidates that stand on those records, and along any run of any process, its moves read as records, a meaning ruled out at a step stays ruled out at every later step. Periphery (propext, Quot.sound; spatial law, catalogue, itinerary and first-match rule supplied; the successful witness starts with 51 support units): after preliminary surveys, a supplied first-match rule reading retained access reports and current binding ambiguity chooses each next visit, the choice changing as the bindings change, and the selected history interprets every encoded sequence. In witnesses: where naming is mistimed, the stopping rule stops on a lexicon resolving both words that answers the utterance false, true, false, where the selected history answers true, false, true; a catalogue of one place leaves the lexicon unresolved with no further choice; with 50 units the acquired lexicon interprets the utterance as intended and executes no response; after a supplied rearrangement, an access report accurate when made can be stale and change the next choice.
- **Base.** any type
- **How far seen.** [encounter-selection-and-revision](../../records/encounter-selection-and-revision.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.CrossSituational.candidates_append`, `Becoming.CrossSituational.narrows`, `Becoming.CrossSituational.stays_iff`, `Becoming.Courses.run_candidates_append`, `Becoming.Courses.run_narrows`, `Becoming.Courses.run_stays_iff`, `Becoming.MachineInstances.acquired_interprets_every`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.binding_changes_which_scene_is_chosen`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.selected_encounters_transfer_to_all_sequences`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.changed_arrangement_can_leave_an_accurate_old_record_stale`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.stale_prediction_changes_choice_before_reobservation`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.reobservation_revises_the_access_model_and_next_choice`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.poor_catalogue_leaves_ambiguity`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.acquired_binding_can_exhaust_response_support`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.removing_coverage_can_make_the_stopping_rule_wrong`, `Generative.EncounterChoice.selected_history_reaches_actual_response`

<a id="a-reading-informed-and-revalued"></a>
### A reading informed and revalued along one law: the updates commute, the courses do not

- **Mechanism.** A named model, ListingValuation: natural-number weights and values, the valuation's scale supplied, discrete steps, the candidate world unchanged, the holding formation's law reading only its own state and the answer. On one blanketed law whose internal part is the reading formation's listing and valuation, its sensory part what it senses, its active part its answer, and its external part the candidate world with the holding formation's state, a demonstration filters the listing by what it shows, an input presented revises the valuation, and the answer is that of the updated state; state and answer change only through what is sensed. Where the acts taken give two worlds one input, from one state of each formation the courses are alike, so they are alike wherever no demonstration is emitted or none tells the two worlds apart. A filter and a revaluation commute as updates, not as courses: in a witness of two worlds, from two starts alike but for the order of two scheduled acts, the answers at step 2 differ and from step 3 on the configurations are one. From different starts, the route shown and the route presented answer alike at every step and end in one state while the valuation changed on the second alone, so whether it changed is not lumped through the answers and the final state, though with the start added it is.
- **Base.** a named model
- **How far seen.** [a-reading-informed-and-revalued](../../records/a-reading-informed-and-revalued.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.ListingValuation.joint`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.world_fixed`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.through_sensed`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.updates_commute`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.inputs_alike_before`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.undemonstrated_alike`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.shown_turns`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.presented_turns`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.shown_removes_least`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.presented_removes_residual`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.shown_course`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.presented_course`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.orders_apart`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.routes_alike`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.changed_apart`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.not_lumped`, `Becoming.ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.lumped_with_start`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [a-reading-informed-and-revalued](../../records/a-reading-informed-and-revalued.md), hypothesis 1: Natural-number weights and values, the valuation's scale supplied, so a comparison across valuations rests on that scale; the reference valuation and the holding formation's model supplied; values read as probabilities and differences only where valid.
  - [a-reading-informed-and-revalued](../../records/a-reading-informed-and-revalued.md), hypothesis 5: Ties release in the answer, as HeldForReading.byReading goes on at ties, while leastThrough stops a cell at ties; rules are functions of the candidate's cell.
  - [a-reading-informed-and-revalued](../../records/a-reading-informed-and-revalued.md), hypothesis 6: In the carrier: discrete steps; the candidate world unchanged by the acts; a demonstration filtering truly by what it shows, its equality decidable; an input presented revising the valuation by a supplied update, in the witnesses adopting the state presented; the answer shown at every step, asked or not; the holding formation's law reading only its own state and the answer, in the witnesses a fixed schedule.
  - [a-reading-informed-and-revalued](../../records/a-reading-informed-and-revalued.md), hypothesis 7: Worth for one decision before any amount forgone; costs enter only as amounts forgone, counted in the units of the weighted totals; the holding formation's going on, switching off and holding change neither the candidate world nor the reading formation, so the worth of holding is counted on the answer as a rule, not along the courses.
